scope: Historical R4 aggregate below; latest real R5/R6 results are separately retained under new_api_real_revalidation. Public synthetic demo is not model accuracy.

formal_independent_semantic_accuracy.method: Retrospective independent manual review of original per-request wire, response and source evidence. Seven fixed development cases, no held-out generalization claim.
formal_independent_semantic_accuracy.strict_definition: All required subquestions answered, no unsupported years, exact source quotes, closed statement references, correct date bindings and support labels.

aggregation: Sum of 8 original response.safe.json.value token fields and corresponding outcome client timings; overrides inconsistent enriched-summary duration 117.85s.
privacy: No private source text, per-case original answer, endpoint, credential or audit identity published.
semantic_failure_categories: unsupported year added in free text
raw publication quote replaced with normalized value
ellipsis used inside purported literal quote
dated claim missing citation to supplied date sentence

new_api_real_revalidation.scope: Seven fixed known development questions per batch; no held-out or production accuracy claim.

changes: Exact same-source continuous quote with complete model-visible coverage
remaining_substantive_failures: Unsupported assertion that two related website reports concern distinct real-world objects
Extra source-specific factual assertion without a matching citation
Separate source passages concatenated into a purported continuous quote
technical_or_binding_limits: Correct publication-date fact represented in a project-event date field
Conditional claim omits a direct project anchor in its own cited statements
Confirmed negation-scope false positive; corrected only in a separate diagnostic candidate with no regeneration
round_R6.score_policy: Original raw outputs and executed-contract scores remain frozen. Diagnostic or contract replay is not a new model accuracy score.

new_api_real_revalidation.privacy: Aggregate metrics and failure categories only; no private source text, company data, endpoint or credential included.
